news.title: New minor risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 75% of Indian stocks, typically moving 7.8% a week. This is considered a minor risk. Share price volatility indicates the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. It also increases the risk of potential losses in the short term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risk Market cap is less than US$10m (₹253.7m market cap, or US$2.71m). Minor Risk Share price has been volatile over the past 3 months (7.8% average weekly change).

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹0.56 loss per share (vs ₹0.38 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹0.56 loss per share (further deteriorated from ₹0.38 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹164.4m (down 61% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹4.93m (loss widened 49% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has fallen by 21% per year but the company’s share price has only fallen by 1% per year, which means it has not declined as severely as earnings.
